scope: Local unchanged-declaration export; no remote acceptance guarantee; fine-tuned and unspecified model categories are not qualified

rules.root: Explicit object type; no root anyOf/$ref or inferred shape
rules.objects: Explicit properties object (including empty); each declaration explicitly additionalProperties:false; required exactly covers declared properties
rules.nullable: One declared type plus null; no absent-to-null rewriting
rules.references: Native offline compilation; only local fragment references exported, productive recursion retained without expansion; unresolved references are operational errors
rules.unknown: Unverified declarations block strict export, including const, minLength/maxLength, $schema/$id/anchors and unknown annotations
rules.combinations: type with anyOf/$ref, or anyOf with $ref, is unverified in this local revision
rules.enum: Only scalar enum values; complex values unverified

local_counting_rules.text: Conservative UTF-8 bytes across property/definition names and string enum values; const is unverified and cannot be exported. This is not a claim that provider characters mean UTF-8 bytes.
local_counting_rules.depth: Schema declaration depth including primitive children; anyOf keeps depth, properties/items add one. Definitions checked independently plus acyclic reference expansion from root. Active-path recursion back edges are not unrolled; shared DAG targets are revisited at their incoming depth. This is a frozen local interpretation, not a universal provider reference-depth assertion.
local_counting_rules.format_name: Nonempty ASCII letters/digits/underscore/dash, maximum 64 bytes, corresponding to the output-format name rule.
local_counting_rules.function_name: Separately frozen conservative local ASCII/64-byte admission rule; no inference of all Responses function-name behavior from Chat Completions.
local_counting_rules.metadata: Envelope name/description and schema title/description UTF-8 count against the same provider metadata capacity.

accounting: Existing 49 JSON metrics unchanged; all graph work, native compilation, metadata, envelope, writer and result copies share one meter. Provider edge counts include actual repeated inspections during reference-depth walks. Retained bytes are logical weights, not process RSS. Extra cumulative provider quantities stay UInt64; large finite allowances do not allocate capacity or weaken native addressable limits.
foreign_boundary: Platform Data/String allocation/encoding implementation instructions are not an RSS or instruction guarantee. No SDK/model/network call occurs.
apple: GenerationSchema, DynamicGenerationSchema and GeneratedContent bridges not implemented or qualified by this C5 increment; no placeholder Apple-typed API; apple-check remains unavailable/omitted from help.
